text:
Maria (People Ops): Quick shoutout roll — huge thanks to everyone who helped set up the town hall today. Felt smooth and cozy, appreciated the help with mics and the snack table :confetti_ball:
Devin: Big +1 to Sudhir for the late-night infra patch. Saved the demo. :raised_hands:
Sudhir: haha I was half-asleep in front of the terminal, but the `kubectl rollout restart` did the trick. Team effort.
Leo: Shoutout to Design (Anya) for the last-minute slides and the on-brand confetti gif :heart_eyes: made everything look so much better
Anya: tiny bit of panic, big cups of coffee, animated gif to the rescue. Teamwork! Also thanks to ops-bot for the deploy alerts (saved us from guessing). :robot_face:
Devin: Also, Customer Success chimed in with a last-minute case study that made the Q&A way more concrete — excellent cross-team support.
Maria (People Ops): Noted — will drop these into the weekly kudos board. If anyone wants to add a 1-liner for the town hall recap, DM me and I’ll pin it.
Sudhir: Special nod to Leo for coordinating the room layout so the AV team could cable-run without a circus. :clap:
Leo: I will accept all praises on behalf of my cable-management personae.
Anya: Also, shoutout to the folks who stayed after to clean up — it's small but means a lot.
Devin: Agreed. Feels good when people pitch in. :sparkles:
ops-bot: :bell: Reminder: if you want public kudos on the dashboard use `/kudos @name reason` — I’ll auto-post on Fridays.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks ops-bot! One last thing — we’ve got a small surprise treat for volunteers tomorrow at 3pm in the kitchen. Come grab a cookie (or two). :cookie:
Sudhir: Cookies are excellent motivators. See you there.
Devin: Thank you team — proud to work with you all :tada:
